en.headline: Extreme heat continues under Very Hot Weather Warning
en.dek: The Observatory issued a special weather tip this morning warning of prolonged extremely hot conditions through the weekend and into next week, with some areas expected to reach 37 degrees or above.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force. A special weather tip issued at 6.45am on Saturday urged the public to stay alert to the ongoing extreme heat.

Under the influence of outer subsiding air from Tropical Cyclone Dolphin, which is moving towards Zhejiang and northern Fujian, extremely hot weather is expected to persist over the weekend and on Monday. Temperatures in some districts may reach 37 degrees Celsius or higher.

The Observatory forecast mainly fine weather today with extreme heat during the day. Urban areas are expected to reach about 35 degrees, with the New Territories a few degrees higher. Isolated showers and thunderstorms are possible later. Members of the public were advised to drink plenty of water, avoid vigorous outdoor activity and seek medical help if they feel unwell.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告持續 天文台籲提防極端高溫
zh.dek: 天文台今早發出特別天氣提示，指受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，極端酷熱天氣將持續至周末及下周一，部分地區氣溫可達37度或以上。
body: 天文台表示酷熱天氣警告現正生效。今日上午6時45分發出特別天氣提示，呼籲市民提防持續極端酷熱天氣。
受熱帶氣旋白海豚移向浙江至福建北部一帶的外圍下沉氣流影響，周末至下星期一本港天氣極端酷熱，部分地區氣溫可達37度或以上。下周中期高溫天氣仍會持續。
天文台預測今日大致天晴，日間極端酷熱，市區最高氣溫約35度，新界再高兩三度，稍後局部地區有驟雨及雷暴。市民應多補充水分、避免戶外劇烈運動，如感不適請盡快求醫。
